q05.question:
Assuming a little endian machine, complete the following code such that the output is "JOSHUA":

typedef union {
    int64_t number;
    char    string[sizeof(int64_t)];
} Data;

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    Data d = {.number = ____};  // Use hexadecimal representation
    puts(d.string);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

Hint: Reverse engineer the solution by setting the .string attribute and printing out the .number attribute in hexadecimal.

q06.question:
Assuming a big endian machine, complete the following code such that the output is "JOSHUA":

typedef union {
    int64_t number;
    char    string[sizeof(int64_t)];
} Data;

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    Data d = {.number = ____};  // Use hexadecimal representation
    puts(d.string);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

Hint: Use htobe64 on the previous hexadecimal number to convert it from little endian to big endian.
